# Provenance: prusaslicer

PrusaSlicer is not installed here, so these files are checked-in upstream samples, copied unmodified on 2026-10-25 from the cloned repositories under `.reference/repos`. All are AGPL-3.0 (both repositories carry the AGPL-3.0 `LICENSE`).

| File | Source | Generated by |
|------|--------|--------------|
| `mini_cube_ps2.8.1.gcode`, `mini_cube_ps2.8.1.bgcode` | libbgcode (`https://github.com/prusa3d/libbgcode`) commit `d4da9073616d70a43c151e8c1d7fbff879d2e08a`, `tests/data/mini_cube_ps2.8.1.{gcode,bgcode}` | PrusaSlicer 2.8.1 on 2024-10-21 (file header `; generated by PrusaSlicer 2.8.1`, bgcode `Producer=PrusaSlicer 2.8.1`), MK4S, 0.2 mm layers, arc fitting `emit_center`. A twin pair of the same slice. |
| `mini_cube_ps2.8.1.twin.gcode` | libbgcode (same commit), `tests/data/mini_cube_ps2.8.1_ref.gcode`, renamed, unmodified | What libbgcode's converter writes for `mini_cube_ps2.8.1.bgcode`. It differs from `mini_cube_ps2.8.1.gcode` only in the order of ten header and footer comment lines (that file keeps PrusaSlicer's own order), so the decoded `.bgcode` equals this file, not that one, byte for byte. |
| `mini_cube_b.twin.gcode`, `mini_cube_b.bgcode` | libbgcode (same commit), `tests/data/mini_cube_b_ref.gcode` (renamed `mini_cube_b.twin.gcode`, unmodified) and `tests/data/mini_cube_b.bgcode` | PrusaSlicer 2.6.0 (file header), MINI, PETG, 0.15 mm layers. The second twin pair; the `.bgcode` is Heatshrink 12/4 with Deflate metadata. |
| `test_arcs_ps2.9.0-alpha1.gcode` | PrusaSlicer (same commit `30ef591...`), `resources/test_data/test.gcode`, renamed, unmodified (3.7 MB) | PrusaSlicer 2.9.0-alpha1 on 2025-02-27 (file header), MINI, ABS, arc fitting `emit_center`, 10,808 G2/G3 lines, single material. Brings the PrusaSlicer arc-fitted check to a large real file. |
| `test_vase.gcode` | PrusaSlicer (`https://github.com/prusa3d/PrusaSlicer`) commit `30ef59195e0f3ee6f270b185bb5f9fb5f349f81f` (last commit touching the file), `resources/test_data/test_vase.gcode` | PrusaSlicer 2.9.0-alpha1 on 2025-03-06 (file header), MK3MMU2 profile with five filaments, vase mode, 0.2 mm layers, arc fitting disabled. |

Not present: a generated 20 mm cube and a multi-material print (the upstream `test_multimaterial.gcode` is 12 MB, over the 5 MB cap). See `../manifest.json` (`pending`).
